pomegranate.why: Key/theme = the FRUIT (fruits). Treccani: melagrana = il frutto (f); melograno = la pianta/albero (m). Current row was incoherent — singular was the tree form while plural was already the fruit form (Melagrane). Aligning singular to the fruit lemma.

coconut.why: singular is Cocco (m); plural of cocco is cocchi, not the different lemma noci di cocco

columbine.why: -gia preceded by vowel keeps i: pl. -gie

diamond.why: singular is Rombo (shape); plural of rombo is rombi, not the diamante lemma

earmuffs.why: para- compound is invariable; p must equal singular Paraorecchie, Paraorecchii is a non-word

fence.why: singular is Recinto (m); plural is recinti, not the recinzione lemma

colander.why: scolapasta is s. m. invariable; no -e plural

deck-chair.why: sdraio is invariable (una sdraio, due sdraio); Sdrai not used

fried-egg.why: Plural of 'uovo' is irregular 'uova' (feminine pl); adjective agrees: 'uova fritte'. 'Uovi fritti' is a fabricated regular plural.
fried-egg.src: Treccani: uovo s. m. (pl. le uova)

french-fries.why: plural-picture (s===p) with fabricated wrong plural; correct form is 'patatine fritte' (patatina f). 'Patatini Fritti' is a wrong masculine-ized form.

guinea-pig.why: Plural must match singular lemma 'Cavia'; plural = 'cavie'. Current plural uses a different lemma (porcellino d'India).

papaya.why: 'Papaye' is a Spanish/non-Italian plural. Treccani lemma papaia (o papaya) s.f. is fully assimilated; regular Italian plural is 'papaie' (-aia/-aya → -aie).

porcupine.why: Plural did not match singular Porcospino (istrice/istrici is a separate lemma). Regular -o→-i.

scallop.why: Treccani gives plural of capasanta as 'capesante' (both parts inflect); 'Capasante' is not the standard plural.

suitcase.why: Treccani gives pl. -gie o ge; 'valigie' is the modern standard plural, 'valige' is marked ant. o merid. (archaic/southern)
suitcase.src: Treccani: valìgia s. f. (pl. -gie o ge)

taco.why: Loanword whose plural Treccani lists explicitly as tacos, not invariable
taco.src: Treccani: taco s. m., ispanoamer. (pl. tacos)

basketball.src: Treccani: pallacanestro s. f., solo al sing.

coconut.why: cocco is masculine (il cocco), matching singular field

fence.why: recinto is masculine (il recinto), matching singular field

forehead.why: 'fronte' meaning forehead is feminine in modern usage (masculine only in some figurative senses).
forehead.src: Treccani: fronte s. f. o m. — 'nell’uso moderno sempre femm.'

knee.why: 'ginocchio' is masculine singular (pl. le ginocchia collective f). Gender field describes the singular lemma.

jeep.why: 'jeep' is used as feminine in Italian.
jeep.src: Treccani: jeep — 'usato in ital. al femm.'

pomegranate.why: As the fruit (melagrana) it is feminine; ties to the singular correction Melograno→Melagrana and the existing plural Melagrane.

venus.why: Venere is feminine, including the astronomy/planet sense
venus.src: Treccani: vènere s. f. ... b. In astronomia, Venere ... il pianeta

walnut-tree.why: noce is masculine as the tree (il noce) and feminine only as the nut (la noce); key is the walnut TREE
walnut-tree.src: Treccani: noce s. m. (albero) / s. f. (frutto)
